summary: The change renames formatPrice to formatMoney, which now takes a currency and formats with Intl.NumberFormat. It also gives invoiceLines a currency parameter that defaults to USD.

findings.title: Removed formatPrice still used by cart
findings.problem: This change removes the formatPrice export from src/money.ts. The cartTotal function in src/cart.ts still imports and calls formatPrice on lines 1 and 8.
findings.consequence: The TypeScript build fails because formatPrice no longer exists. If the code runs without a type check, cartTotal throws at runtime, so customers cannot see a cart total.
findings.fix: Update src/cart.ts to import formatMoney and call formatMoney(addTax(subtotal, taxRate), "USD"). Alternatively, keep formatPrice as a wrapper around formatMoney.

findings.title: Changed money formatting has no covering test
findings.problem: The formatMoney function now adds grouping separators and handles currencies other than USD. No test in the repository exercises formatMoney or invoiceLines.
findings.consequence: A regression in invoice amounts could ship without anyone noticing.
findings.fix: Add tests for formatMoney and invoiceLines. Cover USD, a second currency and amounts of 1000 or more.
